ask: can u set up the imposter game w those 8 campus spots, 5 of us, 1 random imposter, and a vote at the end
sentence: A hidden-word party game where everyone but one random imposter sees a campus spot, each player gives a one-word hint, then all vote on who the imposter is.
use_when: A group wants to play an imposter or spyfall style game in the chat
Players want a secret location with one random player who doesn't know it
The round should end with a vote on who the imposter is
dont_use_when: Only two people are in the chat, since at least 3 are needed
The group wants a simple poll or a single vote with no game
The group wants to pick its own custom word list or a different kind of game, like trivia or a board game
